description: Fast, accurate transcription (Parakeet-TDT-v3, word-level timestamps, no speaker labels) via the host MLX server; Docker faster-whisper (large-v3-turbo) fallback. If the user uploaded an audio file, omit the file arg to auto-detect the most recent upload.
name: transcribe_audio

audio_path.description: Absolute path to audio file. Omit to auto-detect latest upload.

language.description: Language code (e.g. en). Auto-detected if omitted.

description: Transcribe an audio file and label who is speaking: full transcript (Parakeet-TDT-v3) plus speaker turns (Sortformer diarization), merged at the word level. A monologue comes back as one speaker; a conversation gets SPEAKER_00/SPEAKER_01/... per turn (up to 4 speakers). No HuggingFace token. Runs on the host MLX server (:8924); if diarization is unavailable the transcript still returns without labels. If the user uploaded an audio file, omit the file arg to auto-detect the most recent upload.
name: transcribe_with_speakers

file.description: Audio reference: OWUI file ID, filename in uploads/, or absolute path. Omit to auto-detect the most recent upload.

language.description: ISO language code. Auto-detected if omitted.

num_speakers.description: Optional cap on the speaker count — folds over-segmented speakers into the nearest kept one. Inferred when omitted.
